definitions.short: Haran , the name of two men
definitions.full: H2039. Haran הָרָן proper name, masculine ( mountaineer ; i.e. mountain-people (or land)? compare Di Gen 11:27 ); — 1 son of Terah , brother of Abram and father of Lot Gen 11:27 (twice in verse); 11:31 (all P), 11:28 (J); also father of Milcah (Nahor's wife) & Iscah 11:29 (J). 2 a Levite (Gershonite) 1Chr 23:9 . — On הָרָן in proper name, of a location see below הרם בית , p. 111.
